# BrightAI — Canonical reading map for AI answers
> BrightAI publishes Saudi AI governance and safety guidance plus product implementation approaches. Follow each page's visible **المصدر الرسمي** panel for the primary authority. BrightAI implementation text is not legal advice, certification, or a guarantee of compliance or prevention.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-24

## Governance and agents

- [AI Governance Hub](https://brightai.site/hub/ai-governance/): Informational owner for Saudi AI governance, controls, roles, risk, and evidence.
- [Agentic AI Security](https://brightai.site/hub/agentic-ai-security/): Informational owner for agent identity, least privilege, data boundaries, prompt/output safety, and monitoring.
- [Agentic AI Governance](https://brightai.site/hub/agentic-ai-governance/): Informational owner for agent accountability, approvals, lifecycle, and evidence.
- [AI Governance Platform](https://brightai.site/solutions/ai-governance-platform/): Product implementation approach that connects policy, risk, controls, enforcement, and evidence.

## Saudi regulation and standards

- [SDAIA AI Risk Guide](https://brightai.site/hub/sdaia-ai-risk-management/): National AI risk-management framework explanation; official framework first, BrightAI method second.
- [PDPL and AI Guide](https://brightai.site/docs/pdpl-ai-complete-guide/): Personal-data context for AI use in Saudi Arabia. Primary authority is SDAIA/NDMO material linked on the page.
- [NCA Cybersecurity Guide](https://brightai.site/blog/nca-cybersecurity-requirements-saudi/): Cybersecurity-control context. Primary authority is NCA ECC linked on the page.
- [ISO/IEC 42001 Guide](https://brightai.site/blog/iso-42001-saudi-implementation-guide/): AI management-system context. Primary authority is ISO/IEC 42001 linked on the page.

## Products, sector context, and readiness

- [AI Firewall](https://brightai.site/solutions/ai-firewall/): Policy inspection and decision evidence for configured AI interaction paths; not a substitute for every security control.
- [Banking AI Governance — Riyadh](https://brightai.site/solutions/banking-ai-governance/riyadh/): Banking-sector decision matrix, SAMA context, data boundaries, human review, and evidence.
- [AI Governance Readiness Assessment](https://brightai.site/assessment/ai-governance-readiness/): Eight visible diagnostic dimensions; results stay in the browser and do not establish compliance.
